text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp begins today! I've
prepared a
special training regimen
aimed at improving her
concentration!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I mean, come on. We were on the bus
forever.
Lurching back and forth and
back and forth the
whole time...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Uuugh... This is why I hate buses!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho seems unusually delicate
today, so I carry her things to her room
for her and begin
planning tomorrow's
training schedule.
